title: From Data to Action: Accelerating Refinery Optimization with AI
abstract: arXiv:2605.15085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Nowadays refinery optimization utilizes sheer amounts of data, which can be handled with modern Linear Programming (LP) software, but the interpreting and applying the results remains challenging. Large petrochemical companies use massive models, with hundreds of thousands of input matrix elements. The LP solution is mathematically correct, but simplifications are made in the model, and data supply errors may occur. Therefore, further insight is needed to trust the results. The novelty of the paper consists of enhancing the LP solver with a memory, which makes possible to find potential errors in the input data, finding unusual relations in the data on different decision levels, by introducing an anomaly detection tool. Analyzing the potential "anomalies" in the input and output of LP, the subsequent LP solutions can be improved. The Anomaly Detection tool proposed comprises three methodologies. translated_title: 从数据到行动：利用人工智能加速炼油厂优化
translated_abstract: 当今的炼油厂优化需要利用海量数据，这些数据虽然可以由现代线性规划（LP）软件处理，但对结果的解释和应用仍然具有挑战性。大型石化公司使用的模型规模庞大，输入矩阵包含数十万个元素。LP解在数学上是正确的，但模型构建中做了简化，且数据供给可能出现错误。因此，需要进一步的洞察才能信任这些结果。本文的创新之处在于为LP求解器增加了记忆功能，并引入异常检测工具，从而能够发现输入数据中的潜在错误，并找出不同决策层面数据中的异常关系。通过分析LP输入和输出中潜在的“异常”，可以改进后续的LP求解结果。所提出的异常检测工具包含三种方法。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文通过为线性规划求解器增加记忆功能并引入异常检测工具，能够发现炼油厂优化中输入数据的潜在错误及不同决策层面的异常关系，从而提升后续LP求解结果的可信度和质量。
en_tdlr: This paper enhances LP solvers with a memory and an anomaly detection tool to identify potential input data errors and unusual relations across decision levels, thereby improving the reliability of refinery optimization solutions.
